latin_text: Therefore it was the Spirit of the Lord, the spirit of love, that was borne upon the deep, that is, upon the angelic intellect (for love follows understanding). Driven and excited by it, the mind of the angel turns toward God. God said 'Be light made,' and light was made in the angel, the light of intelligible forms.
english_translation: Therefore it was the Spirit of the Lord, the spirit of love, that was borne upon the deep, that is, upon the angelic intellect (for love follows understanding). Driven and excited by it, the mind of the angel turns toward God. God said 'Be light made,' and light was made in the angel, the light of intelligible forms.
exegesis: Genesis Day 1 ('Spirit moved over waters') = Love moved over angelic intellect → Light made = Intelligible forms illuminating angel.
notes: HARVESTER passage: H.TE3.C2.4 | Day 1 Genesis as creation of angelic intellection through love
